sloka: स च राजा नरश्रेष्ठ यज्ञस्य च समाप्तवान् ।फलम् बहु गुणम् राम सहस्राक्ष प्रसादजम् ॥१-६२-२७॥
transliteration: sa ca rājā naraśreṣṭha yajñasya ca samāptavān ।phalam bahu guṇam rāma sahasrākṣa prasādajam ॥1-62-27॥

translations.english: O Foremost of men O Rama the king also obtained from the sacrifics innumerable rewards by the grace of Indra several times greater than expected.
